panels.description: Dusty hidden workshop with chalkboard, analog gauges, brass plate, tools and a covered machine. Alex wipes dust from Adrian's equation. Leave upper board space.
A balanced water-drop mark is stamped into a brass plate beside an empty recess. Leave upper metal space.
Ada finds Adrian's hand-drawn mine map with ink ticks and a pipe symbol. Leave upper map space.
Beneath a cloth, one warm amber optical eye pulses in the darkness. Leave black negative space around it.
